title: Closeout Step 9c does not sweep pre-existing undelivered signal backlog
description: Step 9c ('Hub Signal Bulletin') only delivers signals extracted this session (routed_to=SIGNAL, status changed this session). Pre-existing signals sitting in bytype/signal/undelivered/ from prior sessions are never swept. Result: signal backlog accumulates indefinitely and is never delivered to hub. Fix: at Step 9c, add explicit sweep — for ALL files currently in bytype/signal/undelivered/, deliver any not already present in {hub_path}/WAI-Hub/Signals/incoming/. This drains the persistent backlog on every closeout.
rationale: Discovered by examining session 84 closeout track: only 2 newly extracted signals were delivered despite 25+ sitting in undelivered/. The protocol's 'for each lug with routed_to=SIGNAL' clause is interpreted as session-scoped in practice. Root cause confirmed by reading Step 5c which only scans open/in_progress for status-changed lugs — undelivered/ signals are invisible to it.

fix.addition: Also sweep ALL files in bytype/signal/undelivered/ — deliver any not already present in hub incoming. This drains the backlog.
